subject: Partner-led discovery — schedule technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@cloudbridge.io>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, camila_reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@gsiconsulting.com>
Date: 2026-02-14T15:12:00Z
Subject: Partner discovery recap + proposed next steps (technical deep-dive)

Hi Marissa & Camila,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really useful call. Quick recap from our side and a proposal for a next step: a partner-led technical deep-dive with our GSI (GSI Consulting) to align on integration architecture and deployment models for CloudBridge + Redwood Dedicated.

Key takeaways from today's discovery:
- Primary use case: document ingestion + real-time summarization for customer support (low-latency responses, ~1–2s target).
- Expected throughput: ~800 concurrent sessions during business hours; spiky bursts up to 2k.
- Data constraints: PII-sanitization required before sending to hosted endpoints; interested in Redwood Private for pilot.
- Success metrics: 2x reduction in average handle time, 60% of queries served by cached prefixes.

Proposed next step:
- Technical deep-dive with GSI Consulting + Redwood solutions engineer. Goal: map integration points, review network/VPC options, and agree on a pilot scope.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Feb 17, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue Feb 17, 15:00–16:00 PT
- Wed Feb 18, 09:00–10:00 PT

Agenda (30–45m core + Q/A):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Current infra + data flow (10m)
3) Integration options (Private control plane, Dedicated pools) (15m)
4) Pilot scope, success metrics, next steps (10m)

I've attached our discovery notes and a proposed agenda doc. If one of these slots works, please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite (GCal + ICS). If none work, propose 2–3 times that suit your team.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
priya@cloudbridge.io
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: CloudBridge-discovery-notes.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: proposed-agenda.docx (docx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Partner discovery recap + proposed next steps (technical deep-dive)

Thanks, Priya — great summary.

We'd love to move forward with the technical deep-dive. Jonas (cc'ed) is our Solutions Engineer and will lead the technical portion. Camila will help coordinate logistics from the partner side.

Of the slots you proposed, Tue Feb 17 15:00–16:00 PT works best for our team. If that becomes unavailable, Tue Feb 17 10:00–11:00 PT is our backup.

A couple of asks for the agenda so we can prep:
- Can Alex from GSI Consulting share a short list of what infra/network access you expect during the pilot (VPC peering, firewall rules, any required endpoints)?
- Can you confirm whether the pilot will require dedicated GPUs or if a small Dedicated pool + autoscaling is acceptable for initial testing?

I'll put tentative hold on Jonas's calendar for Tue 17 15:00–16:00 PT and share an agenda doc with internal notes. Please send the invite when you can — include conferencing link and any pre-reads.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference
